text:
maria: Quick sync — planning a small routing policy nudge for APAC edge in the 14:30-14:45 UTC window today. Goal: shift ~10% to apac-new to validate latency/kv-cache behavior. Who can own the deploy and watch the smoke checks?
ashok: I can own the deploy. I'll be on-call during the window. Can we confirm the policy name and exact weight change?
maria: policy is `edge-route-apac-v3`, current weight 0.0 -> we want +10% to `apac-new` (10 -> 90 split). TTL is 60s by default.
leo: Heads-up: keep TTL at 60s for at least 5m after the nudge so caches stabilise. Also add the healthprobe tag so we can eyeball backend errors via /health.
tilly: For monitoring: I'll attach a short Grafana dashboard and set a temporary alert for 5xx rate >0.5% or median p95 latency increase >20%. Link coming in a sec. :mag_right:
maria: Nice — for smoke checks I'll run synthetic queries: short prompt, long prompt, and heavy KV path. Steps: 1) deploy policy change 2) run smoke script `tools/smoke/apac_nudge.sh` 3) watch alerts for 5m 4) if all green, hold for 15m then increase to 25% next week.
ashok: Rollback plan: revert `edge-route-apac-v3` weights to previous values (script `infra/routing/revert_apac_v3.sh`) and force-refresh route caches with `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/refresh?region=apac`. If rollback needed, I will trigger and ping #eng-oncall.
maria: @leo can you confirm runbook link is up-to-date for the `apac-new` backends?
leo: Confirmed. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/apac-new-backend — has steps for backend drainer + warmup.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by ashok at 14:31Z — id=8921.
ashok: Kicking off deploy at 14:33Z. I'll post status snippets here.
maria: Smoke script results (14:36Z): short prompt OK, long prompt small +12ms median p95 (expected), KV-heavy had one transient 502 on replica-2, investigating.
tilly: I see a retry spike on replica-2 — temporary connection error. Alert threshold not crossed. Recommend holding for 10m, running a targeted replication check. :thinking_face:
ashok: Paused additional weight increases. Running targeted healthcheck against replica-2 now. If it fails again, we'll roll back.
maria: Thanks. If we stay stable for 10 more mins we'll call this a successful mini-nudge. Everyone please ack when you can. :thumbsup:
